extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, peer reviewers, and research administrators (research project grants/RPGs)
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of NIH's Simplified Review Framework for Research Project Grants: how the five regulatory review criteria are reorganized into three scored/evaluated factors and how those factors (plus additional criteria) inform the Overall Impact score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factor 1: Importance of the Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Factor 1: Importance of the Research (Significance, Innovation), scored 1-9
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines the regulatory criteria 'Significance' and 'Innovation' into a single scored factor; reviewers assign a numeric score from 1 (best) to 9 (worst) for this factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factor 2: Rigor and Feasibility
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corresponds to the 'Approach' regulatory criterion; reviewers assign a numeric score from 1 to 9 assessing methodological rigor and feasibility of the proposed research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factor 3: Expertise and Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Factor 3: Expertise and Resources (Investigator, Environment), to be evaluated as either sufficient for the proposed research or not
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rather than a 1-9 score, reviewers evaluate whether the investigator(s) and institutional environment provide sufficient expertise and resources; if reviewers judge them not sufficient, they must provide an explanation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Significance — one of the five retained regulatory criteria (Significance, Investigators, Innovation, Approach, Environment)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under the simplified framework, 'Significance' is assessed as part of Factor 1 (Importance of the Research) and contributes to the Factor 1 1–9 score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Innovation — one of the five retained regulatory criteria (Significance, Investigators, Innovation, Approach, Environment)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under the simplified framework, 'Innovation' is assessed as part of Factor 1 (Importance of the Research) and contributes to the Factor 1 1–9 score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Approach — one of the five retained regulatory criteria (Significance, Investigators, Innovation, Approach, Environment)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under the simplified framework, 'Approach' is the core of Factor 2 (Rigor and Feasibility) and is given a 1–9 numeric score based on rigor and feasibility considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigators
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators — one of the five retained regulatory criteria (Significance, Investigators, Innovation, Approach, Environment)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under the simplified framework, 'Investigators' is assessed within Factor 3 (Expertise and Resources) and evaluated as sufficient or not; insufficiency requires reviewer explanation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Environment — one of the five retained regulatory criteria (Significance, Investigators, Innovation, Approach, Environment)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under the simplified framework, 'Environment' is assessed within Factor 3 (Expertise and Resources) and evaluated as sufficient or not; insufficiency requires reviewer explanation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall Impact score
rubrics_metrics.description: All three Factors will be considered in arriving at the Overall Impact score, along with the Additional Review Criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers synthesize Factor 1 (1–9), Factor 2 (1–9), and Factor 3 (sufficient/not) plus any Additional Review Criteria to determine the Overall Impact; the page indicates these elements collectively inform the final impact judgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Review Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional Review Criteria are considered along with the three Factors when determining Overall Impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The framework retains consideration of additional criteria (not enumerated on this page) that feed into the Overall Impact evaluation in addition to the three Factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Review Considerations handled by NIH staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Review of some Additional Review Considerations (Applications from Foreign Organizations, Select Agents, and Resource Sharing Plans) is being shifted from reviewers to NIH staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These specific considerations will no longer be reviewed by peer reviewers under the simplified framework; NIH staff will handle review of these items.
